purpose: candidates for the v9 prospective registry (data/frozen/prospective_v9_protocol.json); approval only through prospective scoring
development_data: all published harvests in the local cohorts (v6/v7 samples <= 2021 plus the opened 2022-2024 test samples); the prospective targets are harvests whose PAM does not exist yet, so none of these years is a confirmation set
inputs: training features from NASA POWER with IMERG Final and CERES (as v7/v8); prospective predictions use the operational sources of the live job; the shift is measured separately (v9 plan section 2) and not corrected here
candidates: same grid as v8 (data/frozen/training_v8_protocol.json): bases, feature sets F1/F2/F3(/F3_no_latlon), Ridge alphas, HGB grid, MLP grid with early stopping, shrinkage 0-1
selection: train_v8.select on all development rows of the pool: internal validation = the last two harvests (2023-2024), internal fit = harvests <= 2021 (publication gap); score on the scope rows, MG+MT 50% per state
registered_candidates: for every crop x scope, the best internal-validation candidate of each learner family (ridge, hgb, mlp), refitted on all development rows; up to 3 candidates per scope; MLPs on CUDA with seeds 101-105, exported and checked on CPU
multiple_comparisons: approval uses Holm adjustment across the candidates of the same crop x scope (prospective protocol)
no_reselection: candidates are frozen when added to the prospective protocol; no candidate is replaced after its first prospective record
